āc ca sukham idaṃ me sthiraṃ bhavatu
parameśvara ! mā naśyatv ity ādi saṃkalpātmako mānasaḥ karmāśayo dharmādhararūpī bhavati,
karmāśayāc ca janmādiduḥkham iti prāg evoktam ity arthaḥ / Sukhabhogakāle rāgajakarmāśayavad
dveṣamohajo'pi karmāśayaḥ pariṇāmaduḥkhahetur astīty āha-- tathā ca dveṣṭīti / Tathā ca
sukhabhogakāle tadvirodhitayā duḥkhasādhanāni dveṣṭi sukhabhraṃśe " duḥkhaṃ me mā bhūt śatruś
ca me naśyatu " ity ādirūpeṇa, tathā duḥkhasādhanāni parihartum aśakto muhyati ca
/ Mānasakarmāśayadvārā sukhasya pariṇāmaduḥkhatvaṃ pratipādya, śārīrakarmāśayadvārāpi tad
āha-- Nānupahatyeti / Śārīraḥ karmāśayaḥ / Etābhyāṃ ca mānasaśārīrābhyāṃ karm
